column1: # IntOGen Compendium of Mutational Cancer Driver Genes - trimmed snapshot
# Source file: Compendium_Cancer_Genes.tsv  (one row per gene x cohort x cancer type; columns SYMBOL, ROLE, CANCER_TYPE)
# Download: https://www.intogen.org/download   License: CC0 1.0 Universal (public domain)
# Citation: Martinez-Jimenez et al., A compendium of mutational cancer driver genes, Nature Reviews Cancer 2020 (doi:10.1038/s41568-020-0290-x)
#   role             - consensus mode of action; majority vote of per-cohort IntOGen ROLE
#                      calls (Act/LoF/ambiguous) collapsed to one value per gene:
#                      oncogene = Act majority | tumor_suppressor = LoF majority
#                      mixed = exact Act/LoF tie | ambiguous = only ambiguous calls
#   n_cancer_types   - breadth: count of distinct IntOGen CANCER_TYPE values (max 86 in
#                      this release) in which the gene was called a driver. General
#                      'how pan-cancer is this driver' signal; NOT len(cancer_types).
#   cancer_types     - semicolon-separated RegNetAgents TCGA codes (subset of the 14) the
#                      gene was called in, via the IntOGen->TCGA cancer-type mapping.
#                      PRESENCE ONLY - no per-cancer-type role is stored (per-cohort role
#                      calls are too noisy: e.g. they flag CCND1, a canonical oncogene, as
#                      LoF in HNSC). Empty when the gene has no RegNetAgents-mappable type
#                      (e.g. a driver only in blood cancers). 'role' above stays the sole
#                      authoritative role regardless of tissue match.
#     NSCLC/LUNG are pooled non-subtype cohorts -> counted for both luad and lusc.
#     Excluded as distinct tumor biology: NPC, PRCC, CHRCC, LIHB, PANET, UCS, MGCT.
